title: DeepSeek reasoning added to the text API
summary:
One text API PR added DeepSeek reasoning, tightened OpenRouter routing, and removed an OpenAI input check.

The text API gained a `deepseek-reasoner` handler. DeepSeek requests now use the selected model and record reasoning content when the provider returns it.

Supported model aliases now map to OpenRouter provider IDs, with `deepseek/deepseek-chat` as the fallback for unknown aliases. OpenRouter errors also get structured handling in the text server.

The text API no longer applies its 56,000-character input check to the `openai` model.

highlights.title: DeepSeek reasoning support
highlights.text: Use `deepseek-reasoner` through the text API. Reasoning content is recorded when the model returns it. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-reasoner).
